label.description: A data/text key (for example "forest.tree"), never player text: the viewer resolves it through TextTable (ADR 052).

plant_job.description: The jobs.json kind that plants a sapling: its effects require soil, set the first stage and consume nothing (checked on load). A forest zone submits it on its empty soil.

grow_days.description: Days from planted to grown (no season: saplings grow every day).

stages.description: Passable tiles.json ids from planted to the last sapling stage, reached at even fractions of grow_days; the first is the tile plant_job sets.

grown_tile.description: The tiles.json id the sapling becomes after grow_days (the chop job's target).
